# Agile Project Management Templates

This directory contains comprehensive templates for implementing agile project management workflows. These templates support Scrum methodology and can be adapted for other agile frameworks.

## 📁 Template Overview

### Core Templates
1. **[Agile_Project_Plan_Template.md](../Agile_Project_Plan_Template.md)** - Complete agile project plan
2. **[Project_Plan_Template.md](../Project_Plan_Template.md)** - Quick start project template
3. **[Sprint_Planning_Template.md](./Sprint_Planning_Template.md)** - Sprint planning session guide
4. **[User_Story_Template.md](./User_Story_Template.md)** - User story format and checklist
5. **[Sprint_Retrospective_Template.md](./Sprint_Retrospective_Template.md)** - Retrospective meeting format
6. **[Product_Backlog_Template.md](./Product_Backlog_Template.md)** - Backlog management and prioritization

## 🚀 Getting Started

### For New Projects
1. Start with the [Project_Plan_Template.md](../Project_Plan_Template.md) for basic setup
2. Use [Agile_Project_Plan_Template.md](../Agile_Project_Plan_Template.md) for comprehensive planning
3. Set up your first sprint with [Sprint_Planning_Template.md](./Sprint_Planning_Template.md)

### For Existing Projects
1. Adapt templates to your current workflow
2. Focus on areas that need improvement
3. Gradually implement agile practices

## 📋 Template Usage Guide

### Sprint Planning Template
**When to use**: Before each sprint (typically every 1-4 weeks)
**Participants**: Scrum Master, Product Owner, Development Team
**Duration**: 2-4 hours for 2-week sprint

**Key sections**:
- Sprint goal definition
- Team capacity planning
- Story selection and estimation
- Task breakdown

### User Story Template
**When to use**: During backlog grooming and story creation
**Owner**: Product Owner (with team input)

**Key sections**:
- User story format (As a... I want... So that...)
- Acceptance criteria
- Definition of Ready/Done checklists

### Sprint Retrospective Template
**When to use**: At the end of each sprint
**Participants**: Scrum Master, Development Team
**Duration**: 1 hour

**Key sections**:
- What went well
- What could be improved
- Action items for next sprint

### Product Backlog Template
**When to use**: Continuous backlog management
**Owner**: Product Owner
**Updated**: Weekly during grooming sessions

**Key sections**:
- Epic and story prioritization
- Dependency mapping
- Release planning

## 🛠️ Customization Guidelines

### Adapting Templates
1. **Team Size**: Adjust capacity planning based on team size
2. **Sprint Length**: Modify timeboxes based on your sprint duration
3. **Tools**: Replace tool references with your actual tools
4. **Process**: Adapt ceremonies to your team's maturity level

### Tool Integration
- **Jira**: Import story templates and use for tracking
- **Azure DevOps**: Adapt work item templates
- **Trello**: Create board templates with these structures
- **GitHub Projects**: Use issue templates based on user stories

## 📊 Metrics & Tracking

### Key Metrics to Track
- **Velocity**: Story points completed per sprint
- **Burndown**: Work remaining vs. time
- **Cycle Time**: Time from start to completion
- **Lead Time**: Time from request to delivery
- **Team Satisfaction**: Regular surveys using retrospective data

### Reporting Frequency
- **Daily**: Standup updates, task progress
- **Sprint End**: Velocity, retrospective actions
- **Monthly**: Overall project health, trend analysis

## 🎯 Best Practices

### Story Writing
- Use the "INVEST" criteria (Independent, Negotiable, Valuable, Estimatable, Small, Testable)
- Include clear acceptance criteria
- Estimate using relative sizing (Fibonacci sequence)

### Sprint Planning
- Set a clear, achievable sprint goal
- Don't over-commit based on historical velocity
- Consider team member availability and holidays

### Retrospectives
- Focus on actionable improvements
- Limit action items to 3-5 per sprint
- Follow up on previous action items

### Backlog Management
- Keep it prioritized and groomed
- Limit work in progress
- Regular stakeholder reviews

## 🔄 Process Flow

```
1. Project Planning
   ├── Use Agile_Project_Plan_Template.md
   └── Set up team structure and roles

2. Backlog Creation
   ├── Use Product_Backlog_Template.md
   ├── Create epics and user stories
   └── Prioritize based on business value

3. Sprint Cycle (Repeat)
   ├── Sprint Planning (Sprint_Planning_Template.md)
   ├── Daily Standups (15 minutes daily)
   ├── Sprint Review (Demo to stakeholders)
   └── Sprint Retrospective (Sprint_Retrospective_Template.md)

4. Continuous Improvement
   ├── Action items from retrospectives
   ├── Process refinements
   └── Tool and template updates
```
